findings.claim: L79 says the trailers of 'the two script commits' were reworded, but its old-to-new map lists five commits (b6b2675e, 6b906c7b, b055335c, 0deec13c, 6355fec6). The text does not say why three more hashes changed, for example that they are descendants rehashed by the rebase. A reader cannot tell which commits had their message reworded and which only changed hash.

evidence: The diff changes only the T6 line (one hash reference in its closing clause) and appends L79 to the Log.
The T6 line's new text, 'script fix `98b28c38`, written `b6b2675e` before the reword of L79', matches the L79 map entry b6b2675e = 98b28c38.
L79 says 'two script commits' while the map covers five hashes.
